intel.lead: Here's the value we computed from your committed facts — each band is math over a cited fact, not an estimate.

points.text: 1 value lever computed from committed facts — every figure traces to a cited source_event_facts row.

tasks.title: Confirm the realized value on Enhancement / change-order leakage
tasks.subtitle: $180,000 realized to date · target $529,200–$756,000
tasks.guide: The realization record carries $180,000 against this lever. Confirm that figure is the one the actuals support — a realized figure confirmed here that the actuals do not carry turns the event's value story into a claim nobody can falsify, which is the failure this stage exists to prevent.
